title: Intelligent Employee Onboarding & Offboarding
description: A fully automated system for user lifecycle management, covering everything from access provisioning to compliance audits.
longDescription: At Kredivo Group, I engineered a zero-touch system to manage the entire employee lifecycle. By integrating multiple platforms, this solution automates access provisioning, manages permissions, and conducts compliance audits during offboarding.
problem: The existing employee onboarding and offboarding processes were manual, time-consuming, and prone to human error. This led to delays in new hires getting access to necessary tools and posed a security risk with lingering access for former employees.
solution: I designed and built a zero-touch automation workflow using n8n and Jira. The system integrates directly with our HRIS. When a new employee is added, it automatically creates accounts, assigns role-based permissions across multiple applications, and sends notifications. For offboarding, it revokes all access, archives data, and creates an audit trail for compliance.
outcome: This project eliminated manual errors, reduced the end-to-end onboarding time by over 80%, and significantly enhanced our security posture by ensuring access rights were always in sync with employee status. It freed up hundreds of IT man-hours per year.

title: Custom AI Agent for Internal Support
description: Developed an AI agent from scratch using n8n and custom prompts to streamline internal processes and information retrieval.
longDescription: To reduce the burden on internal support teams and provide instant answers to common queries, I designed and built a custom AI agent. Leveraging the n8n workflow automation platform and carefully crafted prompts, the agent integrates with our internal knowledge bases and systems.
problem: The internal IT support team was facing a high volume of repetitive queries about company policies, ticket statuses, and common IT procedures. This was creating a bottleneck and preventing the team from focusing on more complex, high-impact projects.
solution: I developed a custom AI agent from the ground up using n8n, connecting it to our internal knowledge bases and Jira Service Management via API. I engineered a series of precise prompts that allow the agent to accurately understand user intent, retrieve information, and guide employees through troubleshooting steps in a conversational manner.
outcome: The AI agent successfully deflected over 40% of common support tickets within the first three months. This led to faster resolution times for employees and allowed the IT team to reallocate approximately 15 hours per week to strategic initiatives.

title: Asset Management System (FBAMS)
description: A full-stack asset management application with QR code integration and mobile support, built to manage IT assets across 10 locations.
longDescription: While at PT FARIKA BETON, I identified a critical need for a centralized IT asset tracking system. I spearheaded the development of the Farika Beton Asset Management System (FBAMS) from the ground up using Laravel and MySQL.
problem: The company lacked a centralized system for tracking IT assets across its 10 locations, leading to inefficient allocation, difficulty in scheduling maintenance, and a higher risk of asset loss. Audits were a manual, time-consuming nightmare.
solution: I single-handedly developed the Farika Beton Asset Management System (FBAMS), a full-stack web application using Laravel, PHP, and MySQL. The system features unique QR code generation for each asset, allowing for quick scans and status updates via a mobile-responsive interface. It provided a central dashboard for real-time inventory management.
outcome: FBAMS provided the company's first-ever real-time view of its entire IT inventory. This dramatically improved asset allocation, streamlined maintenance schedules, and reduced asset loss by 90% in the first year. The time required for annual IT audits was cut from one week to a single day.
